thesis: The post-earnings pop has already been paid for and is fading into a risk-off tape: price is 4 sessions into a pullback on above-average volume, which is mild distribution. Revenue growth has gone from +8.1% to +4.9% to -0.3% YoY, GAAP margin is negative, and debt is heavy, so the 'cheap' label is a value-trap risk with no sector comps to confirm it. Upside to the analyst mean target of 21.6 and to the 21.20 resistance is thin against a stop only about 1 ATR away, so one normal volatile day can stop it out. An unreviewed Item 2.01 8-K filed 2026-11-17 means a completed transaction is unexplained, and the QQQ-led risk-off regime (VIX at the 0.858 percentile, 10-year yield near range highs) raises the odds of a failed support test at 19.70.
